# CK Builds

> CK Builds is a boutique software studio that designs and builds custom quoting engines (CPQ), stage-locked operational workflows, and internal systems for growing businesses.

## Capabilities
- Custom Quoting & CPQ Engines: Deterministic pricing logic modeling floor geometry, material yields, and volume tiers into instant quotes.
- Operational Workflows & Stage Locks: Milestone authorization gates preventing unpaid work and scope creep.
- Internal Dashboards & Client Portals: Centralized operational tools replacing spreadsheets and WhatsApp threads.

## Who it is for
Operational businesses where revenue or delivery is gated on a quote, approval, or staged workflow: manufacturing, custom fabrication, trade services, distribution, and creative studios.

## How a project runs
1. Discovery call: 20 minutes, free. An honest evaluation of whether custom software makes business sense.
2. Scope & Fixed Quote: Based on problem size and workflow complexity, a transparent fixed-price quote and timeline before any build begins.
3. Build & Handover: Direct engineering around real data, staff stress testing, and live deployment. The client receives 100% repository and database ownership.

## Work
- Trelio (https://trelio.in): A live studio product built and operated in-house. Client portal and milestone payment authorization SaaS.
- Apex Packaging & Converting: A reference build demonstrating an industrial CPQ estimating platform for packaging converters. Source: https://github.com/Chanakya2006gt/Industrial-packaging-platform
